i want to go the delhi so what should i wear accordign to delhi weather?

**Current conditions in Delhi (as of the latest report)** - **Temperature:** ≈ 35 °C (feels like ≈ 40 °C) - **Weather:** Clear sky, very little cloud cover - **Wind:** ≈ 6  m/s (moderate breeze) - **Humidity:** ≈ 50 % ### What to wear | Situation | Recommendation (based on the knowledge base) | |-----------|-----------------------------------------------| | **High temperature (35 °C +)** | • Light, breathable fabrics such as cotton, linen, or moisture‑wicking synthetics.
• Short‑sleeve shirts, T‑shirts, or light blouses.
• Shorts, skirts, or lightweight trousers.
• A wide‑brim hat or cap to shade your head and face.
• Sunglasses or other protective eyewear (the sky is clear, so UV exposure is strong). | | **Wind (moderate breeze)** | • No heavy wind‑proof outer layer is needed, but a thin, loosely‑woven cardigan or light jacket can be handy if you’ll be in air‑conditioned indoor spaces where it can feel cooler. | | **Footwear** | • Comfortable, breathable shoes or sandals that allow airflow. Avoid heavy boots. | | **Sun protection** | • Even with clear skies, apply sunscreen (SPF 30 +) to exposed skin.
• Consider a light scarf or shawl for the neck if you’re sensitive to sunburn. | ### Food & drink tips for the heat - **Stay hydrated:** Drink water regularly; aim for at least 2–3 L throughout the day, more if you’ll be active outdoors. - **Light meals:** Fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole‑grain salads are refreshing and help keep body temperature down. - **Cool beverages:** Iced water, fresh fruit juices, or light herbal teas are fine. Warm drinks are optional but not necessary in this heat. - **Balanced diet:** Continue a normal balanced diet; no special restrictions are required beyond staying cool and hydrated. ### Quick checklist before you head out 1. Light cotton/linen top + shorts/skirts or breathable trousers. 2. Hat or cap + sunglasses. 3. Light sunscreen (SPF 30 +). 4. Comfortable breathable shoes/sandals. 5. Reusable water bottle (filled). 6. Optional thin cardigan or shawl for indoor AC. Enjoy your trip to Delhi, and stay cool!
